stories.end_quote: כמו שעה וחצי. ע׳ בהק׳ הגלעד
stories.summary_en: Excerpts from Megillat Yuhasin, Tzemah David and the Hida's Shem ha-Gedolim praise the Maharal of Prague's leadership, wealth and closeness to Emperor Rudolf, who summoned him and spoke with him face to face. According to the Hida, this audience came about through an awesome deed the Maharal performed by means of what was revealed to him from heaven.

tags.why: Praise of the pre-Hasidic Maharal, copied from earlier books
